feature: ITS service case A — Manchester current-twin workflow

user.role: Internal transport analyst / dissertation author (supervised planning brief)

decision.question: Can a bounded current/context review with honestly separated evidence be demonstrated without asserting a live city-wide twin, measured general-road traffic from BODS, or operational general-road current state?

sources.coverage_scope: Bus positions only — NOT general private-vehicle traffic, NOT Manchester-wide road flow
sources.availability_detail: available when BODS_API_KEY configured else not_ready_credential_missing; otherwise no_live

sources.display_name: National Highways DATEX2 operational snapshots (strategic road only)
sources.coverage_scope: Strategic road network only — NOT Manchester city-road coverage; external to Greater Manchester general road network
sources.availability_detail: available when NATIONAL_HIGHWAYS_API_KEY configured else not_ready_credential_missing

sources.display_name: DfT traffic count survey (raw counts / AADF)
sources.availability_detail: accepted_available when snapshot present else not_accepted

sources.display_name: WebTRIS strategic-road site/day reports (strategic road only)
sources.coverage_scope: Strategic road only — external non-Manchester; must never be presented as near_live
sources.availability_detail: accepted_available when snapshot present else not_accepted

sources.coverage_scope: Static reference layer — Greater Manchester static infrastructure

sources.display_name: ONS December 2025 Greater Manchester / Manchester boundary
sources.coverage_scope: Display boundary only — Greater Manchester reference
Authored scenario only — never observed evidence; bounded synthetic what-if input
sources.availability_detail: authored_available — always authorable locally, no provider required

sources.coverage_scope: Synthetic fixture only — not Manchester observation; pinned deterministic square

sources.display_name: Measured general private-vehicle road traffic from BODS
sources.provenance: none — no adapter; explicitly refused as bus-only ceiling
sources.coverage_scope: Unavailable — BODS is bus-only; no general road traffic adapter exists
sources.availability_detail: unavailable — design-only; no live retrieval; BODS ceiling is bus-only (S-005/S-006)

sources.coverage_scope: Unavailable — would require production deployment; explicitly not claimed
sources.availability_detail: unavailable — design-only capability, no live deployment

sources.provenance: none — adapter not implemented per design (DEFERRED)
sources.availability_detail: deferred — DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY, adapter not implemented

steps.title: Inventory evidence via Manchester Evidence Hub
steps.credential_requirement: none — hub renders honest blockers when BODS_API_KEY/NATIONAL_HIGHWAYS_API_KEY absent; no live retrieval

steps.title: Inspect strategic-road context (National Highways) in Manchester Operations
steps.output: Source-separated map layer + near_live strategic-road scene when configured, otherwise honest blocker
steps.credential_requirement: optional — NATIONAL_HIGHWAYS_API_KEY when present yields near_live; when absent shows not_ready_credential_missing blocker, no live retrieval assumed

steps.title: Inspect bus-only live context (BODS) in Manchester Operations
steps.output: live_vehicle scene with bus markers + staleness/outage labelling, or honest no_live placeholder
steps.credential_requirement: optional — BODS_API_KEY when present yields live_vehicle bus-only; when absent shows no_live placeholder; never general road traffic

steps.title: Review historical DfT / WebTRIS catalogues (offline-first)
steps.output: Catalogue view / site-day chart when accepted, otherwise not_accepted placeholder
steps.freshness: historical only — never near_live for WebTRIS
steps.credential_requirement: none — offline-first catalogue; no provider call

steps.title: Compose bounded synthetic incident via Scenario Builder
steps.output: Labelled synthetic bundle + deterministic metric/diagnostic table (labelled synthetic)
steps.credential_requirement: none — bounded synthetic what-if; authored locally, never observed Manchester evidence

outputs.primary: Manchester Current Context Review packet (hub fingerprint + scene SHAs / honest placeholders + synthetic bundle ID + one-page summary)
outputs.quality: Bounded by source ceiling; no mixing of REAL MANCHESTER DATA / REAL EXTERNAL NON-MANCHESTER DATA / SYNTHETIC DATA / SIMULATION OUTPUT / DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY
outputs.provenance: All inputs carry SHA-256 / acceptance path / control-state derivation; packet is reproducible from same workspace without live deployment
outputs.freshness: Declared per source; no promotion of unavailable to fresher state

limitations: No live city-wide twin — DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY (unavailable)
No measured general/private-vehicle traffic from BODS — DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY (unavailable); BODS ceiling is bus-only
No operational general-road current state — unavailable from listed sources; would require measured city-road feed not present
No design-only behaviour presented as implemented — social media ingestion, live twin fusion remain DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY
No Manchester SUMO calibration or VEC chaining claimed — simulation is SIMULATION OUTPUT only
No RSU offloading evaluation — this Manchester current-context workflow does not implement or evaluate RSU load-management; that scope is separate and remains SHOULD/open decision
red_lines: Must not claim live city-wide twin
Must not claim measured road traffic from BODS
Must not claim operational general-road current state
Must not present design-only behaviour as implemented
Must not present REAL EXTERNAL NON-MANCHESTER DATA (National Highways/WebTRIS strategic-road) as REAL MANCHESTER DATA
Must not treat WebTRIS historical as near_live
source_honesty_note: TT-REQ-008 / S-035 RSU load-management investigations are out of scope for this Manchester current-context workflow. Workflow preserves SHOULD priority and does not implement, evaluate, or silently amend those investigations. No detailed RSU strategy material is imported; limitation is recorded here only to preserve source honesty for reviewers.
external_decisions_required: Final supervisor-approved direction for TT-REQ-008 whether comparison becomes MUST — needs Sandra original 4 August Outlook thread with headers (not present)
Whether data-engineering/what-if extension TT-REQ-014 is lifted above MAY — not inferrable from owner choice
Any TfGM/NTIS measured-traffic feed: provider response, access, schema, quota, licence
Randy artifact permission for any private code/data beyond already-cited Q&A (S-007)
Calibration/uncertainty and held-out design for Manchester observation-to-SUMO baseline (MAN-09/MAN-10) — out of scope, carried as blocker
